title: RoomSuspendedMessage
description: State event: something failed after a command was recorded (fail-stop). The room accepts no command until it is recovered; then the server closes every connection of the room and clients reconnect to a fresh table.snapshot. See ADR-001.

reason.description: recovery_needed: a recorded command could not be applied; the room must be recovered.

message.description: A fixed sentence, not for players. The cause is in the server log only: it may name cards.
